name: What persists, what breaks
shape: Two short boxes side by side, three lines each at most: 'persists' (object · question · concepts that cross the focal text) and 'breaks' (what changes, before → after), each line ending in its row id; the quotes are the anchors, shown on demand.
didactic: The rupture test's substance in six lines.
example: Brenner 1985 run 2: persists — social-property relations, the anti-trade thesis; breaks — method, interlocutors, concepts at 1977→1985.
